etiketler.not: neye katkı verdiği kesik alıntıdan çıkarım
etiketler.gerekce_A: w13 'Common contributors include: ... nutrient limitations' - what they contribute to is cut off in the snippet; 'fermentation problems' inferred.
w29 'Many times fermentation never begins because the yeast was killed when it was rehydrated'.
w3 'A long lagtime... may indicate that the wort was poorly aerated'; w8 '8-16 ppm'; w15 'without adequate oxygen, liquid yeast struggl...'.
w16 'Oxygen is less soluble in high gravity worts'; w20 high gravity 'sluggish starts... are more likely'.
w12 'airlocks to have leaks and therefore show no activity'; w30 'Airlock activity, or lack thereof, does not mean there is or isn't fermentation'.

w2 boiling 'forces almost all the dissolved oxygen from it'; w4 '8-16 ppm... to synthesize sterols and unsaturated fatty acids for cell membrane'; w10 'stuck or long fermentations, under attenuated beers'.

w10 'Lack of dissolved oxygen... can cause stuck or long fermentations, under attenuated beers, yeast stress, and off flavors'; w19 'fermentation delay or slow primary fermentation or... undesired components'.
w31 'air is only about 21 percent oxygen... will max out with a wort around 8 ppm'; w15 'sterile air will achieve only around 8ppm'; w14 'O2 saturation (8 ppm)'.
w25 'virtually all of the dissolved oxygen is driven off, resulting in extremely low levels even after it is chilled'.
w13 'injecting pure oxygen into your wort through a stone (1 min for 12 ppm)'; w7 'oxygen wand... 8-10 ppm... in about 60-90 seconds'.
w24 'To limit the oxidative damage, oxygen is added on the cold side and yeast is pitched without delay'; w21 'cold side of the heat exchanger'.
w4 '8-16 ppm... sterols and unsaturated fatty acids for cell membrane'; w22 '5-20 mg/L'; w7 '8-10 ppm'; w3 'process sugars for food and grow'.
w5 'Without aeration, fermentations tend to be underattenuated because oxygen availability is a limiting factor'; w11 'It is unnecessary to aerate wort upon firs[t]...' for dry yeast reserves.
w2 'grassy flavor if... left in contact... too long, so limiting dry-hopping to ten days or less'; w15 'too long (more than a week)'; w27 'After [24-48 h] you're risking grassy'. BJCP + MDPI qualify.
w3 'Fuggle, Mosaic, Tradition, and Boadicea hops... can lend grassy notes, especially when employed as late-kettle or dry hops'.
w26 'Hops or grains improperly stored in a humid area or that got wet... can lead to grassy flavors'.
w18 'β-myrcene, geraniol, or linalool can also impart vegetal or grassy aromas'.
w29 'Too hot (>20°C) increases the risk of grassy flavors'; w8 vegetal compounds 'extract more efficiently at warmer temperatures'; w30 cold 'can lead to raw, grassy, and vegetative flavors'.

etiketler.not: "too much" öznesi kesik; kuru hop miktarı söylenmiyor
etiketler.gerekce_A: w25 (APA hopping) 'Too much... can develop resin and grassy notes'; referent inferred as hops from context.
w9 is about one product: 'Dosing SPECTRUM early... while late dosing will create a grassy, resinous character' - item generalizes to dry hop timing in general, not supported.
w24 'most common cause of grassy off-flavors is from excessive dry hopping contact times'; temperature w29/w30, variety w3, amount w25.
